tips: Overstood the layline by ~6°. Tack onto it a little sooner and sail the last 100 m at full upwind speed.
Came out at 59° to the wind, low and wide (your best exited at 29°). Finish the turn close to close-hauled; the wide entry is what makes a tight exit possible.
Took 84 s to settle upwind (best 27 s). Trim main and jib on through the turn, then speed before height.
Passed 7 m from the mark. Wide in, tight out: leave it about a boat length (3 m) away on the exit.
Reached off at 106° to the wind for the first 15–40 s after the mark (your best exited at 174°). Bear away all the way to the run angle first, then set.
Took 63 s to settle on the run (best 11 s). Pole and halyard ready on the layline, so the set happens as you bear away.
Speed dropped 26% through the turn (4.74 → 3.5 kt; best 6%). A smoother, rounder turn with trim in step with the helm keeps more of it.
